FinancingAllowedSummary.name: Financing Allowed Summary
FinancingAllowedSummary.definition: Specifies summary information about invoices/instalments financed, such as total amount financed, number of single requests accepted.

InvoiceFinancingDetails.name: Invoice Financing Details
InvoiceFinancingDetails.definition: Specifies detailed information about single invoice/instalment financing result, such as result of request (financed or not financed), amount, percentage applied.
